mentions.name: Chucks Football Pool
mentions.description: This app is a rewrite of Chucks [American] Football Pool in the Newspeak language, taken from hard deadline to current state in three weeks. It runs entirely local in the browser with no backend, persisting data in IndexedDB via a Newspeak IndexedDB library the author wrote, making it usable by the masses where the Seaside version had problems; it is Chrome-only.
mentions.problem: The original Seaside version had many problems being usable by the masses due to backend requirements; this rewrite is local-only to eliminate backend headaches.
mentions.audience: Usable by the masses (general public); Chrome only
mentions.source_excerpt:
I rewrote Chucks [American] Football Pool in Newspeak!

Having a hard deadline of Sept 1st, I wasn't sure three months would be enough time. In Newspeak, it took all of three WEEKs to get it to it's current state.

One of the best features is the fact that it's local ONLY. It uses IndexedDB (Newspeak library written by yours truly) to persist the data, meaning zero backend headaches. It also makes it usable by the masses where the Seaside version had many problems in this regard.

Chrome only. No Clod.
mentions.author: goodthink
